highway.name: Wind on the high plains
highway.text: Crosswinds push the pickup around. The driver eases off and holds the wheel steady; nobody gets hurt, everyone's ears ring.

highway.name: Stray goat on the roadway
highway.text: A goat strides across the lane with complete confidence. The driver threads the needle; the goat is unimpressed.

basin.name: Sagebrush haze
basin.text: Dust and sage smell fill the cab after a dry stretch. A stop and a shake-out clears the air for all of you.

mountain.name: High-country switchbacks
mountain.text: Hairpin after hairpin under open sky. The view is spectacular; the ride is not for those who love a soft stomach.

mountain.name: Elk crossing
mountain.text: A small herd stands mid-road. The engine ticks down to idle; the elk debate for a while, then move on.

valley.name: River crossing
valley.text: A bridge over spring water — the driver slows for the washboard on the approach and comes out the far side without spilling a drink.

park.name: Bison traffic
park.text: Bison stroll onto the park road. You stop, watch, and let them go. It's exactly why the trip was worth making.
